title: Gentle Toe Work
summary: Each toe is gently stroked without forceful traction or twisting.
instructions: Hold one toe with a broad gentle grip.
Do not pull or twist the joint.
direction: From the base of each toe toward the tip.
warning: Do not massage with recent injury, marked swelling, ulcers, infection, severe pain, or impaired sensation unless medically advised.
